THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
AFTERLIGHT
016
16 / Tweed Corner
Straight black hair, an ivory bouclé tweed cardigan with
black braided trim, a black-and-white tweed mini skirt, a black
quilted chain-strap bag and black thigh-high socks. She leans
into the corner of a pale gray room with folded arms.
17 / Jade Hanbok
A close portrait in a dark teal studio: hair in low buns with
a decorative hairpin, a black jeogori-style jacket with a crisp white
collar and warm blush makeup. The light falls in a soft diagonal
across the face.
